cases.input: A Python analyzer crashes with a boolean-subscript TypeError when an annotation-only outer name is loaded and the same name is assigned inside a function. Inspection shows the annotation load stores True and a later store indexes used[0].
cases.reason: Both the triggering scope interaction and representation mismatch match the evidenced mechanism.

cases.input: A Python analyzer reports 'bool object is not subscriptable', but no reproducer or usage-state producer has been identified.
cases.reason: Request or inspect public reproduction and current semantic owners before authorizing an edit.

cases.input: An analyzer emits an undefined-name warning for an annotation-only name and does not crash; its usage-state contract is consistently boolean.
cases.reason: An ordinary diagnostic and a coherent different representation do not establish the target defect.
